goal: Create one dependency-ordered, implementation-ready plan that combines the approved zeroxB viewport-normalized sizing, solid block collision/selection, and permanent canvas shell/chat HUD specifications with the earlier product requirements and current codebase patterns.
non_goals: Do not modify runtime source code in this planning task.
Do not install or upgrade dependencies.
Do not change or reinterpret approved product values without identifying a hard contradiction.
Do not merge, push, package or install the application.
Do not expose or modify the configured localhost AI credential.
acceptance_criteria: The plan starts with the required writing-plans header and names subagent-driven-development or executing-plans as the execution skill.
The plan maps exact source and test files before task definitions and follows existing project patterns.
Tasks are ordered so viewport sizing primitives precede collision, linked references and permanent shell/HUD integration.
Every task contains checkbox steps, concrete code or interfaces, exact commands, expected failures/passes and a commit boundary.
The plan covers all acceptance criteria in the three approved 2026-07-25 design specifications and earlier retained-function requirements.
The plan includes database compatibility for source-canvas chat metadata, linked-note reference metadata and no-rewrite compatibility for old canvases/chats.
The plan includes automated tests, TypeScript, production build, locked Cargo, NSIS and Windows hands-on verification gates.
The plan contains no TBD, TODO, vague test instruction, unresolved type mismatch or implementation-blocking ambiguity and is committed for execution handoff.
context_sources: Current canvas, shell, chat, note, store, database and test source files referenced by those specifications.
notes: Use the fixed UTF-8 I/O baseline.
Treat the three approved specifications as one dependency chain: sizing foundation, collision and visual policy, then permanent shell, linked notes and chat HUD.
Retain original file, note, editor, TTS/STT, chat, relation, permission, undo/redo and Windows packaging features.
Use TDD, small tasks and frequent commits. Stop after the implementation plan and independent plan review.
